swaps: jura, bottling: the author's proposal to change the flagship from Jura 10 Year Old to Jura 12 Year Old is refused for now, and only for the lint. The case is strong: the house announced in August 2025 that the 12 replaces the 10 as its first age statement (The Scotsman, The Whiskey Wash, One More Dram), on British shelves from October 2025 and around the world after; the producer's British site files the 10 under previous releases and its American site lists the 12 in the core range. A record written for the 12 cannot lint until plan.json carries it (the name would lack 10), and this refuter may not touch plan.json. For the read-together agent, with plan.json: { "kind": "bottling", "key": "jura", "from": "Jura 10 Year Old", "to": "Jura 12 Year Old", "why": "the house replaced the 10 with the 12 as its first age statement in 2025", "agreed": true, "date": "2026-11-22" }, then the record rewritten for the 12, keeping the key and the card ids sherry-finish and rebuilt: twelve years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks with no sherry finish, 40% ABV, peach, bright citrus and lightly toasted walnut with honey and a little cocoa on the nose (the producer's 12 page and its taste guide); the sherry-finish card then asks whether the 12 is sherry finished (no: the 10 it replaced was), and the 10 moves to others.
No other swap proposed; Talisker, Highland Park, Arran and Tobermory stand with their flagships as the roster names them.
